_comment: Engine time per request in microseconds (trace engine_request.dur_us), keyed platform -> op; '*' matches any, the most specific entry wins. Starting values from the <50 ms keystroke budget (.claude/rules/rust-best-practices.md §3); each platform PR calibrates its own from real runs — never loosen one to hide a regression.

engine_request_us._linux-kde-fcitx5: VirtualBox on the win box runs in NEM mode (VBS holds VT-x): every op 5-30x the UTM guest. Calibrated 2026-09-24 from the first run (fetch_at_pos p95 46.5 ms / max 92.7 ms, derive_custom_search_keys p95 26.1 ms) with ~2x headroom.
